settings.privacy_body_1: API keys ere only mra yer device (localStorage). Kisha vo tok da keys ha vo server — only da AI provider direct. Yer fichas da keys anytime: tak-out da key ma setem, ma wipe da site data.
settings.privacy_body_2: Da app setem jin mra yer device: tih-way yer wile, qisi-tok yer wile, rhae-flatam filter (Web/Native), live-tih setiyen, WCAG filter, AI provider yer use, one API key ha each provider yer set, ma findsing vote data (mak, qorassi, ma fichas-forever). Vo oder data setem ma send.

about.what_body: Dis yer audit-writing kowlting, zhey lajak. Yer du many audit, yer tih same findsing over ma over. Kisha make dis ha vo repeat-tih. Tih da findsing, tak da tok, put mra da report. Felota-fast.
about.what_wcag: Dis go up ha {wcag} (Level A ma AA), web ma native app both.
about.step_1_body: Tok fini yer tih — component name, element type, ma plain-qisi.
about.step_2_body: Use da up/down buttons ha change da rank. Qorassi ha always-first. Fichas-forever ha hide.
about.step_3_body: Pick da findsing chek ha yer. Sek, da list sorted by chek-match.
about.step_4_body: Add vaes-where (p.ex. "Kisha:") ma use AI ha rewrite da tok.
about.feature_ai_body: Yer note, AI rewrite. Yer API key, yer AI provider — vo server setem. Dothraki way.
about.feature_languages_body: UI mra 50+ qisi-tok ki RTL chek. Setiyen ha change.
about.feature_party_body: Setiyen. Under kolors. Yer know me when yer tih me.
about.feature_a11y_body: Build ki WCAG 2.2 chek: focus, live regions, keyboard, reduced motion, high-contrast.
about.coming_auth: Google ma GitHub sign-in ha setem across flatam.
about.coming_custom: Add ma change yer own findsing, setem private, fo-yer-only.
about.coming_ai: Oder AI providers: OpenAI, Google Gemini ma more.
settings.confirm_reset_all_body: Jin fichas walowda setem — API keys walowda — ma ogen ha start. Vo undo, zhey lajak.
settings.unsaved_body: Yer AI setiyen change vo setem. Fini yer wile?

about.step_5_body: Tak da tok ma fix-arakh straight ha yer report. Dothras chek, zhey lajak.

about.what_body_2: Sek, zhey lajak, consistency is key mra dis industry. Kisha wile same tok every time — same impact, same severity, same words. Tih da library, pick da findsing, make it yer own, tak it ha da report. Vo repeat da same tih-journey.
